🟡 **Warning** — Existing saved Anthropic defaults are not updated by this new default

`DEFAULT_LLM_SETTINGS` changes the fresh-install value, but `settings-service.ts` `mergeWithDefaults` spreads stored provider settings after defaults (`gitnexus-web/src/core/llm/settings-service.ts:63-65`), and `loadSettings` returns that merged value for existing session data (`:106-109`). There is no Anthropic model migration in the changed settings-service code. Therefore existing users with the previous default retain `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` instead of receiving the new default; the added test treats that prior default as retired (`gitnexus-web/test/unit/agent-retired-defaults.test.ts:16-20`).

_(the same fix applies at `gitnexus-web/src/core/llm/types.ts:241`)_
